=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:400-433 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In `single_pass_retire_followups`, if the explanatory comment POST fails (lines 407-409 / 426-429), the loop runs `continue` and skips the close call (PR close at line 411), so the superseded follow-up PR stays open.
  WHY: A transient 5xx or network error on the comment write leaves a follow-up PR open against the clean-audited head branch, where it can still merge and move the clean head; the comment POST is not idempotent and should not be retried, but the close is an idempotent PATCH and could still run. Both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). They disagree on the issue loop: gemini says the issue also stays open, while minimax says the issue loop still closes the issue at line 430, leaving an open PR whose issue is closed and no explanation on either.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:844 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `followup-guard` kill switch (`SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED=false` → `reason=disabled`) can never be reached. `run_security_followup_guard` in scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 270-273 passes only `REPOSITORY`, `PR_NUMBER` and `PR_PAYLOAD_FILE`, and the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step env (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 4418-4432) does not set the variable.
  WHY: The guard always sees the variable unset (unset = on), so it still runs, spends up to four API calls per PR, and can hold back auto-merge on a transient `unverifiable` result even after the operator disables it. This contradicts the agents.d/9479-security-pass-retire-superseded-followups.md contract. Both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low); it fails safe.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The line-390 filter also requires the head branch to match `test("^ai/issue-" + ($n | tostring) + "([-/].*)?$")`, so a follow-up PR into the audited head whose branch name does not follow that pattern is never closed or commented. glm adds that the merge-side guard still refuses such a PR and that widening the filter risks closing PRs it should not.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:lines 400-416 (PR loop), specifically line 407 `if ! gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/issues/${retire_item}/comments" -f body="${retire_body}" ...; then` followed by line 409 `continue`, which skips the close at line 411 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment POST must succeed before the close runs. When it fails, the loop runs `continue` and never closes the PR, while the issue loop (lines 419-435) still closes the issue (line 430).
  WHY: A transient error logs `outcome=followup_retire_failed reason=comment_failed` and leaves an open follow-up PR, based on the clean-audited head, whose issue is closed. That PR can still merge, which is the failure #9479 targets. The comment POST is not idempotent, but the close PATCH is and should still be attempted.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:line 844 `if [ "${SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED-}" = "false" ]; then`, reached from scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 270-273 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard's kill switch cannot be reached: the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step env (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 4418-4432) does not set the variable (it appears only at lines 703, 1206, 4387 and 4550), and unset means "guard on". Every other consumer of the variable uses `:-false`.
  WHY: An operator who sets `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED=false` still gets the guard: up to four API calls per non-default-base PR, and auto-merge can be held back on an `unverifiable` result. This contradicts the contractual `reason=disabled` entry in the agents.d registry. It fails safe, so the risk is operator confusion.
